content.title: SAIC secures $1.4B COBRA task order to fast-track warfighting technologies
content.summary: Science Applications International has been awarded the $1.4 billion COBRA, Collaborative Operations for Battlespace Resilient Architecture, task order in support of the Department of War, DoW. COBRA will leverage SAIC‘s (SAIC) expertise in command and control and commercial solutions to rapidly develop and deliver multi-domain warfighting technologies that can be integrated with both new and existing platforms. The task order spans a five-year performance period and is set for a late 2025 start
